$comment: PHPStan identifiers, one line each in this repository's words, with phpstan.org's page; this package's own identifiers name their ARCHITECTURE.md row (ADR-0019, decision 7). Written by hand: PHPStan ships no descriptions.

argument.missing.says: A call leaves out an argument the function needs.

argument.type.says: A call passes a value of a type the parameter does not accept.

assign.propertyType.says: A property is given a value of a type it does not declare.

booleanAnd.alwaysFalse.says: One side of an && is always false, so the whole is.

booleanNot.exprNotBoolean.says: A ! is applied to a value that is not a bool.

class.notFound.says: The code names a class that does not exist.

deadCode.unreachable.says: A statement can never be reached.

disallowed.class.says: A class ARCHITECTURE.md forbids where it is used.

disallowed.constant.says: A constant ARCHITECTURE.md forbids where it is read.

disallowed.else.says: An else; this package has none (C5).

disallowed.elseIf.says: An elseif; this package has none (C5).

disallowed.function.says: A call to a function ARCHITECTURE.md forbids where it is made.

disallowed.method.says: A call to a method ARCHITECTURE.md forbids where it is made.

disallowed.namespace.says: A namespace ARCHITECTURE.md forbids where it is used.

disallowed.staticCall.says: A static call ARCHITECTURE.md forbids where it is made.

disallowed.variable.says: A variable ARCHITECTURE.md forbids where it is read, such as a superglobal.

ergebnis.final.says: A class is neither abstract nor final; this package makes every class final.

function.notFound.says: The code calls a function that does not exist.

identical.alwaysFalse.says: A === comparison is always false, so the branch it guards never runs.

identical.alwaysTrue.says: A === comparison is always true, so the condition says nothing.

if.alwaysTrue.says: An if condition is always true.

method.notFound.says: The code calls a method the class does not have.

missingType.generics.says: A generic type is named without its type parameters.

missingType.iterableValue.says: An array or iterable type does not say what it holds.

missingType.return.says: A function or method has no return type.

phpstan.says: PHPStan failed without naming an identifier.

property.notFound.says: The code reads a property the class does not have.

return.type.says: A function returns a value of a type it does not declare.

shipmonk.missingNativeReturnTypehint.says: A function's return type is known but not declared in its signature.

staticMethod.notFound.says: The code calls a static method the class does not have.

variable.undefined.says: The code reads a variable that may not be set.
